subject: Archaeology
title: Citizen Science in Archaeology
description: A micro-lesson that makes Citizen Science in Archaeology usable.

hook.text: You do not need a degree. Thousands of volunteers find new archaeological sites from home.

buildup.text: GlobalXplorer lets anyone scan satellite tiles for looting. Over 100,000 have joined.

discovery.text: MicroPasts invites volunteers to 3D-model objects and transcribe old dig records.

twist.text: A volunteer on GlobalXplorer spotted an unrecorded site in Peru that experts missed.

climax.text: Open data makes archaeology democratic. The public is now part of the research team.

punchline.text: You can discover an ancient site from your couch.

quiz.question: What is GlobalXplorer?
options: A GPS app guiding tourists to archaeological sites
A platform where volunteers scan satellite images for looting
A database of every excavated site on Earth
